# Bank of Z on IMS: log in (the PL/I IBLOGIN), account summary, customer
# details read and updated, log out
send IBLOGIN  000000001 secret
expect PASSWORD INVALID
send IBLOGIN  000000001 password
expect LOGIN SUCCESSFUL
send IBLOGIN  000000001 password
expect CUSTOMER ALREADY LOGGED IN
# two accounts: LL X'0047' (28 + 2 x 17 bytes + ZZ and LL)
send IBACSUM 000000001
expect hex  00470000
send IBACSUM 000009999
expect CUSTOMER DOES NOT EXIST
send IBGCUDAT 000000002
expect GAUDREAU
# the details of customer 2 replaced (binary customer number)
sendhex IBSCUDAT 
expect Smith
send IBGCUDAT 000000002
expect Jane                                              Smith
send IBLOGOUT 000000001
expect LOGOFF SUCCESSFUL
